args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least, per the companion piece.
• Implication: contract rates remain stable, so carrier diversification and fuel-surcharge timing are the key levers for cost control.
args.title: Freight Pricing Summary (Tamarack blog + companion)
